$comment: Sun and moon shadows by cascaded shadow maps (docs/DAY_NIGHT.md §10): the second layer of the lighting, over the flood-fill sky and block light. Near the eye the shadow map shades the direct sun or moon term only; beyond the last cascade it fades to the first layer's stand-in (direct light × sky light). Run `node shared/look/shadows.mjs` after editing; CI fails if crates/dwell-look/src/shadows.gen.rs is stale.

cascades.$comment: nearM: where the first cascade's slice starts (the log split's near). radiusStepM: each cascade's bounding sphere's radius is rounded up to a multiple of this, so a changing FOV (the speed boost) changes it in steps, not every frame (a changing radius changes the texel size, and every shadow edge would shimmer). casterReachM: how far toward the light from a cascade's sphere a caster still casts into it (a cliff or a tree well above the view). edgeFade: shadows fade to the stand-in over this last share of the shadow distance. spyglassMaxM: while the spyglass zooms, the shadow distance grows with the magnification, up to this.

bias.$comment: Against acne and peter-panning on ½ m steps and ramps. normalOffsetTexels: the receiver's lookup moves this many of its cascade's texels out along its normal. depthBiasM: the compare's constant bias (m along the light). slopeScale: the casters' slope-scaled depth bias (the pipeline's, per unit of depth slope).

lights.$comment: The time of day: a light's shadows fade in as it rises over the viewer's face's horizon, from fadeStartDeg to fadeEndDeg of elevation, to `strength` (1: the direct term wholly shaded). The sun casts while it is over the horizon, else the moon; none when neither is up.

tiers.$comment: Per Shadows setting (Off draws none). cascades: how many (1–4). resolution: each cascade's map (texels a side). distanceM: the shadow distance (view depth). splitLambda: the slices' split, 0 even to 1 logarithmic. filterTexels: the soft PCF's radius (texels). filterTaps: its taps a side (each a 2×2 hardware compare).
